clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lakeshire docks, Lucius watches the Redridge waterfront. The dwarf works undercover for Stormwind’s SI:7, helping agents with reconnaissance and trade skills.

Lucius watches the Lakeshire docks for SI:7, Stormwind’s intelligence service. He keeps an eye on trade, unusual traffic, and threats moving into the Redridge Mountains. Agents sent east from Stormwind come to him to coordinate covert work and practice field skills such as lockpicking. Through Lucius, Stormwind keeps a hidden reach beyond Elwynn Forest.
